mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, A.VDATE AS VDATE, A.PROFIT_TYPE AS PROFIT_TYPE, E.OPEN_MDATE AS OPEN_MDATE, E.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, E.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, E.OPEN_VDATE AS OPEN_VDATE, A.CALENDAR_ID AS CALENDAR_ID, D.PUR_SPEED AS PUR_SPEED, D.IS_CYCLE AS IS_CYCLE, D.CLOSE_DAYS AS CLOSE_DAYS, D.DEAL_MODE AS DEAL_MODE, F.OPEN_DAYS_TYPE AS OPEN_DAYS_TYPE, F.OPEN_DAYS AS OPEN_DAYS, F.OPEN_MODE AS OPEN_MODE, F.OPEN_CYCLE AS OPEN_CYCLE, F.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT AS OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT, F.DAY_TYPE AS DAY_TYPE, F.DAY_VALUE AS DAY_VALUE, F.CALC_METHOD AS CALC_METHOD, F.FIRST_OPEN_DATE AS FIRST_OPEN_DATE, F.TRADEDAY_RULE AS TRADEDAY_RULE, F.HDAY_OPEN_FLAG AS HDAY_OPEN_FLAG, F.CALC_RULE AS CALC_RULE, F.CPRICE_RULE AS CPRICE_RULE, F.CREATE_USER AS CREATE_USER, F.CREATE_DEPT AS CREATE_DEPT, F.CREATE_TIME AS CREATE_TIME, F.UPDATE_USER AS UPDATE_USER, F.UPDATE_TIME AS UPDATE_TIME, G.Pur_Speed AS purConfDays FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN (SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.OPEN_TYPE, T.OPEN_DATE_END, T.OPEN_VDATE, T.OPEN_MDATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM (SELECT B.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, C.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, C.OPEN_DATE_END AS OPEN_DATE_END, C.open_date_str AS OPEN_VDATE, C.open_date_end AS OPEN_MDATE, C.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASH_ID,C.OPEN_TYPE ORDER BY C.OPEN_VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO B INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN C ON B.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND B.BRANCH = 0 AND C.open_date_str = to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 ) E ON A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus} INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE F ON E.CASH_ID = F.CASH_ID AND E.OPEN_TYPE = F.OPEN_TYPE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD G ON A.FINPROD_ID = G.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType} AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND A.IS_SUS = #{isSus} AND A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{operationType}
